windows_hosted_proof.policy: The exact hosted Windows installer must install silently on a fresh runner, and the installer, installed application, and uninstaller must each have a valid Scott Converse Authenticode signature and timestamp. The receipt installer hash must match SHA256SUMS.

macos_preflight.note: This local preflight proves the merged v0.3.3 code and unsigned Gatekeeper path. DMG container bytes are not reproducible, so the release workflow separately smoke-tests the exact hosted DMG and binds that hosted receipt hash to SHA256SUMS.
